summary: Tank Battle - 经典坦克大战 Web 版 PRD 细化规格说明书，采用纯前端 TypeScript + HTML5 Canvas 开发，包含 Roguelike 升级系统、夜战模式及特殊地形逻辑。

This plan covers the full implementation of **Tank Battle** — a 2D top-down NES-style tank shooter built with TypeScript, HTML5 Canvas, and Bun. The project starts from an empty repo (only config files present). The implementation is a ground-up build of ~20 source modules, 5 level definitions, and 16 test files (8 E2E + 8 unit). Three blocking goals drive the work: a functional night-mode rendering pipeline, a complete passing test suite, and a playable game with all core systems (state machine, AABB collision, enemy AI, upgrade system, special terrain).
